snippet.title: BlindSide - Audio Adventure Game Trailer
snippet.description:
http://www.blindsidegame.com

BlindSide takes the video out of video games, and tosses players into a fully rendered 3D world that they'll never see. Players explore their environment guided only by what they hear in the world around them and their memories. They must figure out why they are unable to see, while avoiding the vicious monsters that now stalk the streets. 

BlindSide offers an identical gameplay experience to both sighted and visually impaired players, and features a gyro control scheme that allows players to change the direction they're facing in the game just by rotating their bodies in the real world.






For our visually impaired visitors:
The trailer opens with Case, a young man, and Dawn, a young woman, sleeping in bed in an apartment. It is dark and appears to be nighttime. The image shows static in concert with the static sounds as if there is something wrong with the camera. The next shot shows an empty hallway. With the first low note, the text "What if you woke up..." appears on the screen. The next shot shows Dawn waking up and tapping Case on the shoulder. The text "and you were blind?" appears on the screen with the second low note. Case waves around a flashlight as if it were off and not working, but the flashlight is on. The text "Would you survive..." appears on the screen with the third low note. Case gets out of bed. The text "if the things in the night..." appears. Case walks into the previously empty hallway and feels his way along the wall toward the next apartment. The text "did more than go bump?" appears. Dawn is sitting up in bed in the next shot, and then hears something and startles. The screen goes to static and a scream and roar are heard. The music plays with the BlindSide logo with the text "A terrifying new kind of audio adventure" and a link to the website blindsidegame.com
